task.title: Compare immutable extension registry snapshots
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/607 by comparing two already-discovered snapshots deterministically without filesystem access or activation.
acceptance_criteria: Represent added, removed, and changed exact IDs explicitly with borrowed discovered records.
Order changes deterministically by exact caller-authored ID.
Treat a source-path or validated-manifest difference for the same ID as changed.
Return no changes for equal snapshots while preserving case and whitespace as identity.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for immutable snapshot comparison.
attempts.diagnostic: ExtensionRegistry exposed discovery and lookup but had no change type or comparison operation.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests requiring explicit added, removed, changed, equal, moved-path, ordering, and exact-ID behavior.

attempts.diagnostic: A sorted union of both exact-ID maps can classify changes without reopening the filesystem or mutating either snapshot.
attempts.patch: Added ExtensionRegistryChange, changes_from, public documentation, and milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Refined edge coverage and the public contract.
attempts.diagnostic: Path changes and case-or-whitespace-distinct IDs needed explicit coverage so comparison could not drift toward normalized identity.
attempts.patch: Added path-change and exact-ID tests and clarified the non-activation and explicit-refresh boundaries.

outcome.summary: Vela can now compare immutable extension registry snapshots as deterministic borrowed added, removed, and changed records without activation or refresh side effects.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-extensions --locked registry_
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30180986960 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/608

lessons: Snapshot comparison can stay independent of filesystem refresh and capability lifecycle policy.
A sorted union of exact identities makes both classification and output order deterministic.
Source path is part of a discovered extension record even when the manifest metadata is unchanged.
Identity-preserving comparisons must not trim, case-fold, or normalize caller-authored IDs.
